study_info.description: One-line summary of what the trial studies, from the titles and summary.

inclusion_criteria.description: One entry per distinct requirement a participant must meet to enrol, split out of the registry's free-text criteria blob. Split compound criteria into separate entries when they state independent requirements.

text.description: The requirement as a short standalone clause, e.g. 'Age 18 years or older'.

exclusion_criteria.description: One entry per distinct condition that disqualifies a participant, split out of the registry's free-text criteria blob.

text.description: The disqualifying condition as a short standalone clause.

genetic.description: Gene/protein biomarkers explicitly named in the registry record.

text.description: HGNC symbol for the gene/protein explicitly named in the anchored sentence. Normalize registry aliases (e.g. p16→CDKN2A, HER2→ERBB2).

evidence_anchor.description: Verbatim phrase naming this same biomarker (symbol, protein, or alias).

role.description: inclusion: required for enrollment; exclusion: disqualifies enrollment; other: biomarker named outside the entry criteria.
